name: Recipe: Southbank Master-Cook’s Pot-Roasted Bean Ration Brick

text.content:
Southbank Master-Cook’s Pot-Roasted Bean Ration Brick

Ingredients: bean, brown bread, brown bread

Tools: cook’s utensils and region-appropriate heat source.

Time: 4 hours

Difficulty: expert

Batch: 1 serving(s).

Failure: ingredients are consumed; the result becomes a spoiled Tier 1 ration with no benefit.

Partial success: half yield, no mechanical effect, safe to eat.

de.content:
Southbank Meisterkoch- Pot-Roasted Bohnen Rationsblock

Zutaten: Bohne, Graubrot, Graubrot

Zeit: 4 hours

Schwierigkeit: fachkundig
